current_evidence: The council's 'Application process' page (new.fylde.gov.uk/?p=2658, 'Applications are validated') links to this checklist page, and planning.data.gov.uk entity 20085 lists the same URL as Fylde's local requirements document; the page shows no adoption or update date (only the (c) 2026 footer).

issues.detail: Grokbot captured none of the 27 items in the page's 'Local Requirements' section. All are missing from tab_items and app_type_rows: Affordable housing statement; Air quality assessment; Biodiversity survey and report; Economic statement; Environmental statement; Town Centre Uses evidence; Flood risk assessment; Foul sewage and utilities assessment; Heritage statement (incl. historical, archaeological features and Scheduled Ancient Monuments); Land contamination assessment; Landfill statement; Landscaping details; Lighting assessment; Noise impact assessment; Open space assessment; Parking provision; Photographs and photomontages; Planning obligations Draft Heads of Terms; Planning Statement; Site waste management plan; Statement of community involvement; Structural survey; Telecommunication development supplementary information; Transport assessment; Travel plan; Tree survey/arboricultural implications; Ventilation/extraction statement. The source gives names only, with no thresholds, apart from the heritage statement.
issues.evidence: 'Local Requirements' heading: 'The Council may also require that one or more of the documents set out in the following...' followed by the 27 named items

issues.detail: Heritage Statement trigger not captured. The page states a Heritage Statement is needed for works to a listed building or in a conservation area, which should have appeared under Listed building consent and Demolition in conservation area (and Householder/Full in a conservation area). Grokbot shows '(none)' for those types.
issues.evidence: Intro text: Heritage Statement needed for works to a listed building or in a conservation area (linked PDF guidance, 309KB)

issues.detail: All 3 tab_items are boilerplate, not requirements: the drawing-reference/schedule note (drawing standard), the page title and intro sentence 'Validation Checklist - Fylde Council Validation Application Checklist The following checklist should be used...', and the paragraph encouraging Planning Portal submission to save printing costs.
issues.evidence: tab_items sections 'Drawing / document standards', 'Local forms / checklists', 'Submission rules'

issues.detail: The only app_type_row requirement, Design and Access Statement under Full planning, has a garbled trigger 'Order 2015 Design and Access Statement, if required The appropriate fee.' It joins the end of the Agricultural Holdings Certificate line with the fee line. The D&AS is also a national requirement (the page only says 'if required'), not a local one, and its placement under Full planning is an INFERRED guess.
issues.evidence: Checklist lines: 'Agricultural Holdings Certificate ... Order 2015' / 'Design and Access Statement, if required' / 'The appropriate fee.'

issues.detail: Householder, Outline, Listed building consent, Advertisement consent and every other type are marked 'No specific local requirements identified ... national requirements only'. That is wrong: the page lists 27 local requirements that can apply to any application. Status 'Captured' / 'Req. items 1' overstates the extraction.
issues.evidence: reference_row Req. items '1'; source page lists 27 local requirements

issues.detail: Plan requirements on the page were not captured as requirements: location plan at 1:1250 (site edged red, other owned land blue), block plan (e.g. 1:100/1:200), existing and proposed elevations and floor plans, site sections/levels for sloping sites, and roof plans. Most are national or common requirements, but the page sets local expectations for scale and content.
issues.evidence: Section 4 'Other plans and information': block plan, elevations, floor plans, sections and levels, roof plans

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Fylde validation checklist page (undated), but the extraction is almost empty: its 3 tab items are boilerplate and it missed all 27 named local requirements plus the Heritage Statement trigger for listed buildings and conservation areas.
